title: Sparkly cupcake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>

  <path d='M28 58 L72 58 L66 88 Q50 93 34 88 Z' fill='url(#case)'/>

  <path d='M64 58 L62 90 L66 88 L70 58 Z' fill='#ffc0d9' opacity='0.55'/>

  <rect x='36' y='50' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5ac8ff' transform='rotate(-25 39 51)'/>
  <rect x='56' y='52' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7de87d' transform='rotate(20 59 53)'/>

    <circle cx='68' cy='18' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='30' cy='82' r='1.8'/>
